title: Clubs seek legal advice after Man City found guilty over financial rule breaches
description: Premier League clubs are seeking legal advice as to whether they would have a case for financial compensation as a result of City's breaches.

title: The computer hacker who tried to take down Man City
description: BBC Sport travelled to Portugal to find out more about Rui Pinto - the computer hacker who sparked the Manchester City investigation.

title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
description: Asked about the Iranian proposal, a US official told the BBC "constructive discussions" were taking place through mediators.

title: Burnham not doing enough to boost growth, says former business secretary
description: Ex-Business Secretary Peter Kyle calls for more urgency on the economy, as Labour members head to the party's annual conference.

title: E-motorbikes seized by police sold on at auction, BBC finds
description: Thousands of electric motorbikes are confiscated annually because they are suspected of being driven illegally or used in a crime - most are destroyed, but last year police sold at least 161.

title: Joshua fight at risk over promoter row, says Fury
description: Tyson Fury says his long-awaited all-British heavyweight fight against Anthony Joshua in December is in jeopardy.

title: Bangkok declares disaster as heavy rains spark flooding
description: Days of near continuous downpours have caused widespread flooding in the Thai capital.

title: Your child has left home. Here's why it's time to stop checking up on them
description: Parents say social media groups and tracking apps are feeding their anxiety about children who have recently gone to uni.

title: How the bare nails trend became a class issue
description: Bare nails - or nails that appear that way - are a growing trend. But is it as innocent as it seems?
